core_rights_summary.no_disclaimer: §1790.1 — implied warranty disclaimer void for consumer goods (non-waivable)
core_rights_summary.repair_or_replace: §1793.2(d) — after reasonable number of attempts, manufacturer must replace or refund
core_rights_summary.tanner_presumption: §1793.22 — 4+ attempts OR 30+ days out of service within 18 months/18,000 miles = rebuttable presumption
core_rights_summary.civil_penalty: §1794(c) — up to 2× actual damages if manufacturer's failure was willful
core_rights_summary.mandatory_fees: §1794(d) — attorney fees mandatory for prevailing buyer (one-way fee shift)

interpretive.cite: Robertson v. Fleetwood Travel Trailers, 144 Cal.App.4th 785 (2006)
interpretive.rule: Cumulative defects can constitute a §1793.2(d) nonconformity even if no single defect would be sufficient; substantial impairment measured against buyer's reasonable expectations.

interpretive.cite: Brand v. Hyundai Motor America, 226 Cal.App.4th 1538 (2014)
interpretive.rule: §1794(c) willfulness = knowing non-compliance with replacement/refund obligation. Formal demand ignored after Tanner presumption triggered = willfulness evidence. Civil penalty up to 2× is discretionary.

redjag_jaguar_xe.song_beverly_analysis: Sold with manufacturer express warranty. Yo-yo financing, wrong CARFAX, and stripped vehicle suggest both (1) Rees-Levering void contract and (2) vehicle delivered non-conforming with warranty. Document any warranty repair attempts (ROs). If 4+ attempts or 30+ days out of service: Tanner presumption triggered. Demand letter to manufacturer required before filing.
redjag_jaguar_xe.action: Obtain complete repair order history from dealer. If warranty repairs were attempted, send §1793.2(d) demand letter citing Tanner presumption. Proceed to Song-Beverly claim + CLRA + Rees-Levering + UCL compound.

kiasoul.song_beverly_analysis: If sold new or certified pre-owned with express warranty, Song-Beverly applies. Same analysis as RedJag — document repair history.
kiasoul.action: Obtain repair order history. Determine warranty type at sale. If qualifying defects: same compound filing strategy.

demand_letter_checklist: Send demand BEFORE filing suit (provides evidence of willfulness for civil penalty)
Demand: replacement vehicle OR full refund of purchase price minus mileage offset
Send CLRA §1782 demand simultaneously (CLRA requires 30-day pre-suit notice before seeking damages)
